exposure: time interval since last cesarean (<=5 years)
cohort: The study included 122 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy who underwent hysteroscopic surgery and 90 pregnant women with prior cesarean sections and normal intrauterine pregnancies as a control group.
finding: Hysteroscopic surgery improves treatment outcomes and offers superior diagnostic accuracy for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), with surgical failure linked to factors such as gestational age and gestational sac characteristics.
gest_age: Gestational age of the pregnancy at the time of intervention was a measured variable and a significant factor for surgical failure.
